# 📍 Project Status Report Template

## 1. Reporting metadata

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Reporting period | |
| Prepared by | |
| Maintainer/decision owner | |
| Current source branch | |
| Current commit SHA | |
| Release tag, if any | |
| Report date | |

## 2. Executive status

State whether the project is on track, blocked, or in review. Explain the evidence behind the status. Do not use a status badge as a substitute for actual facts.

## 3. Implementation state

| Area | Planned outcome | Actual implementation | Evidence/link | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Product behavior | | | | |
| Source/build | | | | |
| Unit/integration tests | | | | |
| Documentation | | | | |
| Security/quality | | | | |
| Release/distribution | | | | |

## 4. Completed work

List merged items, changed files, user impact, test evidence, and any migration required.

## 5. Work in progress

| Item | Owner | Next milestone | Dependency | Expected evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|

## 6. Risks and blockers

| Risk/blocker | Likelihood | Impact | Mitigation | Owner | Decision needed |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

## 7. Quality signals

Record exact build, test, documentation, static-analysis and dependency-review workflow runs. Include failed or skipped checks and explain why. Do not calculate coverage from assertion counts.

## 8. Scope changes

Explain features accepted, deferred, rejected, or removed. Distinguish implemented functionality from proposals and explicitly list non-applicable systems.

## 9. Next reporting period

List prioritized deliverables, owners, dependencies, review needs and measurable acceptance criteria.

## 10. Sign-off

| Reviewer | Decision | Date | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
